summary.text: Steve Bunker is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 75, Franklin County, representing Chesterville and Farmington.
The page lists committee service on Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry and Criminal Justice and Public Safety.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Steve Bunker's education as SMCC, USM, UMO (A.A., B.S., MED., 1972, 1974, 1977).
The page lists Steve Bunker's occupation as Retired Educator.
The page lists military service: U. S. Army (3 years), U.S. Coast Guard Reserves (23 years).

Listed affiliations include American Legion Post 28, BPOE Elks #2430, Rotary Club - Farmington, Sportsman Alliance of Maine, Greater Franklin County Chamber of Commerce, Farmington Fire and Rescue - Volunteer.
Steve Bunker lives in Farmington and has served 1 session in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry (member); Criminal Justice and Public Safety (member).
Family details on the page: married, spouse Cheryl.
